comment: Professor Alley is the most helpful, he is always there for any questions and is very patient and professional, one of my favorite professors.

I'm taking Photoshop online.  He is so helpful.  Makes me wish it was an in-class course.
His classes are a breeze which relieves pressure and thus improves interest and motivation to learn.
Great Professor - fun and makes learning fun!
